content: I am trying look at lean4 as Haskell substitute and matching their features. So far so good, but what about STM? If it is missing right now, what perspective to have it soon?
STM is not available right now and there are currently no plans to make the (rather substantial) changes to the runtime required to add it.

I’m very interested.

How does Lean FRO plan to support parallel and concurrent programming in Lean?
Well you can already do it, there are tasks, locks, channels, promises etc. All available, just no STM
